title: Irreducible-support step assuming smaller-support filtrations
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, T a closed subset with generic point ξ, and F a coherent module with support T. Assume every coherent module with support strictly contained in T has a coherent integral-ideal filtration. Then F has such a filtration. This step only handles irreducible nonempty support and explicitly assumes the smaller-support induction hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 01YF, ideal-power and generic-inclusion paragraphs, using Tags 01Y9 and 01YE

proof.text: Apply the J-adic reduction. For each coherent graded quotient supported in T, use hsmaller if its support is proper. Otherwise use the generic-annihilated step with the supplied hsmaller. Its ideal-sum inclusion and smaller-support cokernel give the filtration by coherent extension. Concatenate the graded filtrations; the zero power endpoint has the length-zero filtration.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentIntegralFiltration_of_irreducible_support
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (T : TopologicalSpace.Closeds X) (ξ : X)
    (hξ : IsGenericPoint ξ (T : Set X))
    (hsmaller : ∀ (G : X.Modules), RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G →
      {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (G.presheaf.stalk x)} ⊂ (T : Set X) →
      HasCoherentIntegralFiltration G)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (hSupp : {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk x)} = (T : Set X)) :
    HasCoherentIntegralFiltration F
